answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, published publicly on failure. Every claim climbs the anchor of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the sonnet re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. What survives to the marble is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
